original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-differential-d1}
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $(K, F, d)$ be a filtered
differential object of $\mathcal{A}$. The spectral sequence
$(E_r, d_r)_{r \geq 0}$ associated to $(K, F, d)$ has
$$
d_1^p :
E_1^p = H(\text{gr}^pK)
\longrightarrow
H(\text{gr}^{p + 1}K) = E_1^{p + 1}
$$
equal to the boundary map in homology associated to the short
exact sequence of differential objects
$$
0 \to \text{gr}^{p + 1}K \to F^pK/F^{p + 2}K \to \text{gr}^pK \to 0.
$$

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $(K, F, d)$ be a filtered
differential object of $\mathcal{A}$. The spectral sequence
$(E_r, d_r)_{r \geq 0}$ associated to $(K, F, d)$ has
$$
d_1^p :
E_1^p = H(\text{gr}^pK)
\longrightarrow
H(\text{gr}^{p + 1}K) = E_1^{p + 1}
$$
equal to the boundary map in homology associated to the short
exact sequence of differential objects
$$
0 \to \text{gr}^{p + 1}K \to F^pK/F^{p + 2}K \to \text{gr}^pK \to 0.
$$
hypotheses: Let $(K,F,d)$ be a filtered differential object of an abelian category, with its associated graded spectral sequence.
conclusions: The $d_1^p$ differential from $H(\operatorname{gr}^pK)$ to $H(\operatorname{gr}^{p+1}K)$ is the connecting map of the indicated short exact sequence of differential objects.
